messages:
ana: Hi team, Im Ana, started today on platform. Trying to provision a GCS bucket in asia-southeast1 for a demo but getting blocked. Anyone know who owns region policies / billing association?

ana: Command I ran: `gsutil mb -l asia-southeast1 gs://ana-demo-bucket-2026`

ana: Error: 
```
ServiceException: 403 Could not create bucket: The resource location is restricted by organization policy: constraints/gcp.resourceLocations
```

marcus: welcome Ana :wave: looks like an org policy is preventing that location. Two common causes: (1) billing not attached to the project, (2) org policy restricting allowed locations. Which project are you using?

ana: using `redwood-sandbox-2026`. I can list project resources but not create resources in some regions.

marcus: run this to view effective org policy (requires viewer):
```
gcloud org-policies describe constraints/gcp.resourceLocations --effective-policy --organization=123456789012
```
if it shows a whitelist, asia-southeast1 might not be allowed.

jen (cloud-finance): tagging here. If the project has no billing account attached you can get region errors for some services. Ill check billing for `redwood-sandbox-2026`. If you need quick access, I can attach the reading billing account (readonly) and then we can open a scope request to enable region.

leo (sso-admin): on the AWS side Ana, you mentioned in onboarding doc you need to assume `RedwoodCrossAccountDev` in account `210987654321` for infra tests. Any issues?

ana: yes, trying `aws sso login` then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/RedwoodCrossAccountDev --role-session-name ana-test` returns `AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole`. The SSO tile appears but assume fails.

leo (sso-admin): two quick checks: 1) confirm your Okta groups map to the role, 2) some accounts have an SCP blocking AssumeRole from our SSO principal. Ill inspect the account SCPs.

marcus: for GCP org policy changes we need a cloud-security review. If jen can attach billing we can file the change request to add asia-southeast1 to allowed locations.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CI-4805  `org-policy-region-request` assigned to cloud-security and infra-ops. ETA: 2 business days.

jen (cloud-finance): I attached billing account `BILL-0xdeadbeef` to `redwood-sandbox-2026` (project role: billing.accountUser). Ana, try the bucket command again and paste any new error.

ana: re-ran `gsutil mb -l asia-southeast1 gs://ana-demo-bucket-2026` -> still blocked but error now says org policy denies region. So billing was not the blocker, its the allowed-locations policy.

leo (sso-admin): checked the AWS account 210987654321: your Okta user is mapped but the account has an SCP that restricts `sts:AssumeRole` for non-admin groups. I asked cloud-security to evaluate.

infra-bot: Updated CI-4805: cloud-security acknowledged, added to sprint triage. Ticket CI-4806 created: `aws-scp-assume-role-evaluation` assigned to cloud-security.

marcus: until cloud-security approves, you can use `asia-northeast1` which is allowed for sandbox resources. If the demo can run there it's a useful workaround.

ana: switched to asia-northeast1 and bucket creation succeeded. Thanks for the workaround!

jen (cloud-finance): FYI I documented the billing attach step in the onboarding checklist (docs/redwood/onboarding/cloud-access). If cloud-security approves the location policy update well add asia-southeast1 to the sandbox whitelist.

leo (sso-admin): For AWS, cloud-security flagged the SCP as intended (we tightened it after last year). If you need cross-account assume for your role long-term, well need an exception request and justification. Ill follow up in CI-4806.

ana: perfect — appreciate the quick help everyone. Filing a short note in my onboarding doc about the region caveat. :+1:
